_comment: Golden tool path for POST /v1/gaia/query: a request that requires a read tool (e.g. list files under home) must reach a status line, call a tool, return its result, and end in exactly one final with no error. The tool_call milestone is the anti-fabrication pin — a polished answer produced with zero working tools fails this baseline. Ordered-subsequence match, not an exact list (status/token counts are LLM-non-deterministic).
